verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a legal-document and notarization API, so tracking contract deadlines is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows notarization, incorporation, translation and tax-registration endpoints, plus webhooks for notarization and appointment events. Nothing documents tracking contract renewals or deadlines, or letting an agent act before they lapse. The Compliance API is mentioned without any description of deadline monitoring, so it cannot be credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent monitor contract renewals and deadlines through the product's API and act before they lapse
